# Blending

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Configure WebGL blending mode for layers (additive, normal, subtractive).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/blending",
  "type": "BlendingOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/blending').par.mode` (an input) and `op('/blending').out.parameters` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.mode`, `out.parameters`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `mode` | `StringLiteralField` | `"normal"` |
| `blendColorSrcFactor` | `StringLiteralField` | `"src-alpha"` |
| `blendColorDstFactor` | `StringLiteralField` | `"one-minus-src-alpha"` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `parameters` | `UnknownField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
